movie_title: Why Our Ocean Maps Are Terrible
introduction: The maps of our oceans are incomplete, or at the very least they are very low resolution. #shorts

vocabulary.definition: a technique that uses sound propagation to navigate, communicate with or detect objects underwater

vocabulary.definition: the degree of detail visible in an image or display
vocabulary.example: The high-resolution satellite image revealed intricate details of the city.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the sky or outer space
vocabulary.example: Astronomers study celestial bodies like stars and planets.

vocabulary.definition: waste material or unwanted things that are considered useless or of little value
vocabulary.example: Efforts to clean up ocean garbage are essential for marine conservation.

vocabulary.definition: the remains of a ship that has been wrecked or sunk

vocabulary.definition: too numerous to be counted; very many
